guide.title: Guide
guide.subtitle: Learn how to manage transfers, quotations, and customer communication.
guide.s1Body: dantrip.com lets you manage transfer requests end-to-end: from customer submission to confirmation and completion. Each request goes through a defined lifecycle with email notifications at every key step.
guide.s2Step1: The customer visits your booking link and fills out the transfer request form.
guide.s2Step2: They receive a confirmation email with a link to track their request.
guide.s2Step3: Once a quotation is sent, the customer receives an email and can accept or reject it directly from their request page.
guide.s2Step4: After accepting, the customer can add departure details (date, time, flight number) for each route.
guide.s2Step5: When the trip is confirmed by you, the customer receives a final confirmation email.
guide.s3Step1: A new request appears on your dashboard with status PENDING.
guide.s3Step2: Review the request and send a quotation with price, extras, and optional notes.
guide.s3Step3: If the customer accepts, the status moves to ACCEPTED. You can then confirm the trip.
guide.s3Step4: Before confirming, make sure departure details are set (or ask the customer via chat).
guide.s3Step5: Once confirmed, mark it as COMPLETED when the transfer is done.
guide.statusPENDING: New request, waiting for a quotation.
guide.statusQUOTED: A quotation has been sent to the customer.
guide.statusCONFIRMED: The trip has been confirmed by the operator.
guide.s5Email1: Customer: request received — sent immediately when a new request is submitted.
guide.s5Email2: Customer: quotation ready — sent when you notify the customer from the quotation form.
guide.s5Email3: Customer: trip confirmed — sent when you confirm the trip.
guide.s5Email4: Customer: new message — sent when you send a message in the chat.
guide.s5Email5: Admin: notifications for new requests, customer messages, quotation responses, and departure detail updates.
guide.s6Tip1: Use the chat on each request to communicate directly with the customer without leaving the platform.
guide.s6Tip2: Set a default quotation message in Settings so you don't have to type it every time.
guide.s6Tip3: The 'Ask for departure details' button in the confirmation modal prefills the chat with a ready-made message.
guide.s6Tip4: The Events card on each request shows a full chronological log of all key actions.

landing.featuresSubtitle: From the first quote request to the final confirmation — fully covered.

landing.feature3Desc: Admins get notified on every new request. Customers are emailed when their quote is ready or their booking is confirmed.

landing.feature5Desc: Available in English and Italian. Serve international customers effortlessly.
landing.feature6Desc: Run multiple brands or companies from a single platform. Each has its own portal, admins, and requests.

landing.step2Desc: Review the request, create a quotation with pricing and extras, and send it to the customer with one click.
landing.step3Desc: The customer accepts, provides pickup details, and you confirm. Everyone gets notified automatically.
